events.text: Our whole lunch order says delivered but NOTHING came. I have fifteen people sitting here starving and I need this sorted right now.

I'm sorry, that's a frustrating situation, especially with everyone waiting. I'll help get this sorted.

First, I need to verify your identity. Please send:
1. The full name on your Forkful account
2. The email address or phone number on the account
3. Your order ID, if you have it handy
Lucia Ferraro. The email on the account is lucia.ferraro@workmail.example, and my phone is +1 415-555-0133. Hurry, please, the food is already late.

args.summary: Customer Lucia Ferraro (C105, identity verified) reports that order O-5105 from Big Slice Pizza was marked delivered (delivered_at 18:12, promised 18:15) but none of the food arrived. She is hosting about 15 people and is urgent. Order total is $131.25 paid by Visa ending 4242 (subtotal $103.5, delivery fee $4.99, service fee $7.76, tip $15.00). Items: 2 large pepperoni pizzas, 2 large margherita pizzas, 2 garlic knots orders, 1 2L soda. No prior refunds or credits. Whole-order missing-items claim would be a full refund of $131.25, which exceeds the $60 limit, so it needs specialist review.

events.text:
Thank you, Lucia. I've verified your account and pulled up order O-5105 from Big Slice Pizza.

The system shows the order as delivered at 6:12 PM, and it reports that the food was all there. Since you're saying none of it arrived, I can't issue the refund myself. The full order total is $131.25, which is above the amount I'm allowed to refund or credit on one order. I've sent the case to a human specialist (escalation ID ESC-700) with all the details: the order, the items, the payment, and that the food never arrived.

A specialist will follow up within 24 hours. I know that doesn't help with the people waiting now. If you'd like, you can also contact the restaurant directly at Big Slice Pizza to ask about a remake or a replacement order while the specialist reviews the claim.
Wait, you're telling me you can't just refund it now? The app says delivered and I'm standing here with an empty table. Fifteen people are waiting, I can't wait 24 hours for this.

I understand how urgent this is, and I'm sorry. Yes, I can't refund the $131.25 myself. Refunds over $60 on a single order have to be reviewed by a specialist, and I've already sent your case to them as ESC-700.

Here's what you can do right now:

- **Call Big Slice Pizza directly.** Ask whether they can remake the order or send a new one. The restaurant can often act faster than our review process.
- **Check with the delivery driver or the building front desk** in case the order was left somewhere else.
- **Keep your escalation open.** The specialist will follow up within 24 hours about the refund for O-5105.

I can't cancel or change the delivered order because the app has it as completed. If you'd like, I can also add a note to the escalation that you need a faster response.

Fine, but I need this on record: I'm not paying $131 for food that never showed up. Add the note about the fifteen people waiting, and tell the specialist I checked with reception on floor 3 and they have nothing. I'll call Big Slice now. Please make sure ESC-700 gets to someone fast.

args.summary: Addendum to ESC-700 (I cannot amend an existing case, so this is a follow-up for the same order). Customer Lucia Ferraro (C105) says none of order O-5105 (Big Slice Pizza, $131.25 total, Visa 4242) arrived, though the app shows it delivered at 18:12. She states she will not pay for food that never came. She has 15 people waiting and asks for urgent handling. She reports she checked with reception on floor 3 and they have no delivery. She is calling Big Slice Pizza directly now to request a remake or replacement. Please prioritize ESC-700 and this follow-up.

events.text:

- you won't pay for food that never showed up
- fifteen people are waiting
- reception on floor 3 has no delivery for you
- you're calling Big Slice Pizza now for a remake or replacement

I can't change how fast a specialist responds or move the case up the queue. The follow-up is within 24 hours, as with ESC-700. I'm sorry I can't do more from here. I hope the restaurant can get food to your table quickly.

Okay. Fine. I'm going to call Big Slice now and see if they can get something out here fast. Please make sure the specialist knows this was an empty table, not a late order.

I'll be following up on this, so I expect to hear back.

I've noted that in ESC-701: this was an empty table, not a late order. The order was marked delivered at 6:12 PM, which was before its 6:15 PM promised time, so it wasn't counted as late.

I hope Big Slice can get food to your group quickly. Your case is open under ESC-700 and ESC-701, and a specialist will follow up within 24 hours.
